description: Update an existing wiki page's title, body, published state or editing_roles. Only the fields you pass are sent to Canvas; omitted fields are left unchanged. body is not merged — it replaces the entire HTML body, so read the current content with get_page first and send back the full edited body, not just the changed part. Returns the updated page. Idempotent: calling it again with the same fields produces the same resulting page. Use create_page to make a new page instead, delete_page to remove this one, and update_course's syllabus_body parameter to edit the course syllabus, which is not a wiki page editable here. Requires permission to manage wiki content in the course.
name: update_page
title: Update Page
